sites.name: Mcbride Springs Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $10 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: Situated on the lower slopes of Mt. Shasta at an elevation of 5000 feet, this popular campground has 12 sites with tables and fire rings, suitable for tents and small RV's. It has vault toilets and a 7 day stay limit. It usually opens by Memorial Day weekend and closes near the end of October.…
sites.directions: From the Mt. Shasta Ranger Station, head east on Alma Street (towards the mountain). Cross the railroad tracks and turn right at the signal onto Mt. Shasta Blvd. Continue two blocks to the next…
sites.reservations: First Come. No reservations. There is a 7days stay limit per person, per year.

sites.name: Red Fir Flat Group Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Group (nonelectric) Site: $12 per night
sites.about: Red Fir Flat Group Campground is located on the southern slope of Mt. Shasta at 6,400 feet in elevation. Snowpack in this location may extend into late June on heavy snow years, and usually sees late season snowfall in early November, possibly October. It is a popular site for meditation/retreat…
sites.directions: The campground is located on the west side of the Everitt Memorial Hwy above the town of Mt. Shasta.
sites.restrictions: Campfires are allowed with a California Campfire Permit unless prohibited by Forest Order
sites.reservations: Reservations can be made for this campground at recreation.gov
